fields.incident_description_long:
INCIDENT: Deepfake / manipulated media incident
CASE REFERENCE (local): case_89a1fd7baac3

DESCRIPTION
A face-swapped meme traced from an Instagram post to copies on other accounts. Shows the spread map, versions and leads. Source: https://www.instagram.com/p/DMzd8nbIqAo/

FORENSIC FINDINGS (indicators, not conclusions)
- Instagram: www.instagram.com: Weak manipulation indicators (forensic indicators level: Weak).

LOCATIONS WHERE THE MEDIA WAS FOUND
- https://www.instagram.com/p/DMzd8nbIqAo/ | Instagram | account: unknown | published: 01-08-2025 13:04 IST | state at last check: live (18-10-2026 00:36 IST)

TIMELINE
- 01-08-2025 13:04 IST: Published — Instagram: www.instagram.com [Verified; source: page metadata (as displayed/declared by the site)]
- 01-08-2025 13:04 IST: Earliest DISCOVERED appearance of this media family (Instagram) [Inferred; source: earliest dated copy among those discovered]
- 18-10-2026 00:36 IST: Case opened [Verified; source: system clock]
- 18-10-2026 00:36 IST: Captured by investigator — Instagram: www.instagram.com (live) [Verified; source: system clock at capture]
- 18-10-2026 00:36 IST: Original evidence file preserved (649967781_17887871106445952_6183172345105601016_n.jpg?stp=c288.0.864.864a_dst-jp) [Verified; source: custody ledger]

WHAT IS NOT YET KNOWN
- Who created the media and who operates the accounts listed above. The accounts are listed because they were observed posting the media. This is not an allegation that they created it.

REQUESTED ACTION
- Removal of the content from all platforms listed.
- Preservation of account, login and upload records for the accounts listed, pending investigation.
- Investigation into the creation and distribution of the media.

platform_reports.how: Use 'Report' on the post/profile; for intimate or impersonation content use the Help Centre forms.
platform_reports.grievance: Meta's India Grievance Officer contact is listed in the Instagram Help Centre.
platform_reports.text: I am the person depicted (or reporting on their behalf). The following content is AI-manipulated media impersonating me. Please remove it and preserve related account data. URLs: https://www.instagram.com/p/DMzd8nbIqAo/. Under India's IT Rules 2021, intermediaries are expected to act promptly on complaints about intimate or impersonating (including artificially morphed) content.
